description: Prepare accepting an open offer (orderHash: orderId from get_land_order_book) on a property the wallet holds (Sepolia Testnet). Checks first that the offer is open and the wallet holds the token, and warns when it expires within a day, is far from Fabrica's estimate, or the property is collateral for a loan. Signing sells the property. Prepared, not sent: returns a signRequest (summary, warnings, signLink to fabrica.land, expiresAt 15 minutes out, payload null for now) and stores it so the sign page can load it. The person opens the link, signs in with that wallet and signs; nothing happens until then. The server holds no keys and submits nothing. wallet is the address that will sign.

orderHash.description: The order's hash: orderId in get_land_order_book

tokenId.description: The token ID of the property

wallet.description: The wallet that will sign (0x address). The sign page only lets this wallet sign.
